analysis:
The only changes in ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift are in unloadModel. At head lines 1133-1137, a Nemotron Super retirement now calls selectedModelRecovery.makeAllDue(now: .now) when retirement succeeds. At head lines 1201-1204, the normal unload path calls the same method after retryReserveDeferredPrefetches(). The comment edit has no effect.

These edits only schedule an earlier capacity-recovery check for waiting selected models. They add no code that decrypts, handles keys, handles attestation, authorizes, or touches the prefix-cache SSD tier. The unload ordering is unchanged: unregister the bridge, release the assistant and container, remove the slot, clear cache, refresh the reserve, regrow survivors, then persist the loaded set. T-041 cache purge and TTL behavior are unaffected. The model-load path in base lines 552-1044 is unchanged and was read only as context. It keeps its weight-hash TOCTOU guard and its unwind ordering, so I see no regression against T-012, T-027 or T-041.

Remaining unverified points are outside the supplied evidence. I could not see selectedModelRecovery.makeAllDue's implementation, so I cannot confirm it is bounded and non-reentrant. It is called on every successful unload, and if it triggers immediate loads, repeated load and unload cycles could be a thrash risk (T-029-adjacent availability). The behavior is also untested here for add-on holds (TB-012, T-059), where unload during a hold could cause recovery to reload models. I could not check whether recovery respects servingDrain.owner == .addonHold. These are integration questions, not demonstrated findings.
